==Leathers==
Players can also tan hides themselves with the [[Lunar spells|Lunar spell]] [[Tan Leather]], which requires 78 [[Magic]] and the [[Fremennik Diary#Hard|Fremennik Hard Diaries]], without paying any coins. The cost of the spell whilst wearing a source of infinite fire runes (such as a [[Staff of fire]] or a [[Tome of fire|Tome of fire)]]) is {{NoCoins|{{#vardefineecho:costpercast|{{#expr:{{GEP|Astral rune|2}}+{{GEP|Nature rune|1}}}}}}|c}}, tanning up to 5 hides at once.
